Opt in to OCR elements to get each word's text, bounding box and confidence

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), mime_type="image/png", uri="https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"force_ocr\":true,\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"tesseract\",\"element_config\":{\"include_elements\":true,\"min_level\":\"word\"},\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"eng\"]}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].ocr_elements)

asyncio.run(main())
```
